summary: Takeda files Form 6-K to report a jury verdict in U.S. antitrust litigation regarding AMITIZA, awarding $884.9 million in single damages subject to trebling and further proceedings. The filing does not involve a corporate transaction, strategic review, or structural change; it is a litigation update and financial revision. Takeda plans post-trial motions and an appeal. No deal terms are present. This is a routine current report on legal proceedings, not a special situation.
